'''Avidich''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Avidich system/Legends|Avidich system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] within the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It was located on the [[Vagaari Corridor]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through the Unknown Regions. Avidich was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] world with peaks that were considered impressive. The planet was used by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to cultivate edible [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Avidich was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the planet in grid coordinates E-8.<ref name="TEA" />
